newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks expected to follow Wall St down.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks expected to follow Wall St down.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to be dragged down by Wall Street at the open today, possibly ending four days of gains, brokers said.
"Consolidation could be the order of the day after the recent gains," said a trader with a local brokerage, adding that Wall Street's losses should push the Hang Seng Index down.
The Dow industrials fell 45 points overnight to close at 6563.84, wiping out most of its 53 point advance on Tuesday.
The Hang Seng Index rose 28.11 points to end Wednesday at 12,426.68, while the Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 8.83 points at 12,435.51 overnight.
